dimensions.assessment: Affects aged, blind, or disabled Alaska Natives and descendants who hold interests in or receive distributions from Alaska Native Settlement Trusts and apply for need-based federal programs.
dimensions.evidence: an interest in a Settlement Trust and, for the 5-year period beginning on the date of the enactment... an amount distributed from or benefit provided by a Settlement Trust to a Native or descendant... who is an aged, blind, or disabled individual

dimensions.assessment: Directly impacts individual benefit eligibility and financial calculations for qualifying recipients of need-based programs such as SNAP.
dimensions.evidence: from being used to determine eligibility for certain programs

dimensions.assessment: The source does not provide specific federal fiscal or budgetary cost estimates related to program eligibility changes.
Amends Section 29(c) of the Alaska Native Claims Settlement Act with respect to exclusions for specific federal program determinations.
dimensions.evidence: Section 29(c) of the Alaska Native Claims Settlement Act (43 U.S.C. 1626(c)) is amended

dimensions.assessment: Establishes a temporary 5-year protection period for distributed amounts and benefits following the date of enactment.
dimensions.evidence: for the 5-year period beginning on the date of the enactment of the Alaska Native Settlement Trust Eligibility Act

missing_information: The exact number of Alaska Natives or descendants who will qualify for the trust payment exclusion.
Federal budgetary impact estimates for affected need-based programs.
importance_detail.rationale: H.R. 42 excludes certain settlement trust payments from being counted when determining need-based federal program eligibility for aged, blind, or disabled Alaska Natives or descendants for a 5-year period.
